description.narrative: Enerjisa Enerji A.S. (Enerjisa or the Company) operates as Türkiyes leading company in electricity distribution, retail sales and customer solutions. Reaching a population of 22.1 million with more than 11 thousand employees, the Company serves 10.6 million customers within 14 provinces across 3 distribution regions. The Company also provides energy efficiency and renewable electricity generation solutions via its Customer Solutions subsidiary; and electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions via its subsidiary, E-Sarj. The Company is implementing a capital expenditure plan entailing (i) distribution network modernization for its distribution subsidiaries for the fourth implementation period, (ii) reconstruction of earthquake affected network of Toroslar EDA?, and (iii) expansion of EV charging network of E-Sarj (the Project). IFCs support entails (i) an IFC A loan of US$150 million denominated in TRY, and (ii) US$10 million loan equivalent exposure for interest rate swaps for IFC A loan. The proposed IFC investment will partially finance the distribution related capital expenditure of the Project and will mark the first sustainability linked loan (SLL) of the Company.

The Project will finance a portion of Enerjisas capex plan in the fourth implementation period entailing (i) modernization capex for all three regions, and (ii) reconstruction of the earthquake-affected network. The main expected project-level outcomes stem from increasing the quality of the supply of electricity by rehabilitating and modernizing key distribution assets in its three distribution regions, AYEDAS, Baskent, and Toroslar, and by supporting the reconstruction of the earthquake-affected network in the Toroslar region. The anticipated market creation effects stem from financial integration, as IFC is offering the first SLL with a Theft and Loss (T&L) ratio reduction and a gender KPI for the Company. Given that SLL financing in Türkiye has traditionally been dominated by financial institutions, the Project is expected to have demonstration effects by showcasing SLL products for the infrastructure market, thus contributing to developing the sustainable finance market in Türkiye.
